## Change pushed: Gerrit 2673

https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2673 — commit `459e1d1b099f`,
"Take the runtime module reconcile itself resolved".

Files:
- `tests/interfaces/store/test_reconciler_apply_bindings.py` — patch `reconcile._runtime`
  (the object `reconcile.py:197` hands to `bind_operation_runtime`) instead of loading a
  second `rebar_reconciler.runtime` by path.
- `tests/interfaces/store/test_reconciler_apply_bindings_engine_identity.py` — new regression
  test that manufactures the split-engine topology in any install mode.

Verification:
- `make verify` on the worktree: `All checks passed!` + `19704 passed, 77 skipped` (30m37s).
- Non-editable venv, macOS lane's `-n 3 --dist worksteal`, over `tests/interfaces` +
  `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler` + the two reconciler-adjacent unit files: **6159 passed, 0
  failed** (before the fix on the same selection: 1 failed, 6155 passed).
- Seeded-defect: reverting the oracle turns the new test RED with the CI assertion verbatim.

Not closing until the change is `Verified +1` and merged.
